title: Usability Checklist
description: Schema for a completed Usability_Checklist.md metadata block — tracks which usability principles were evaluated and the outcome.

evaluator.description: Always the UX/UI Designer — self-review before submission.

section_name.description: Name of the usability checklist section.

items_total.description: Total checklist items in this section.

issue.description: Description of the usability issue found.

severity.description: Severity: critical = blocks task completion; high = significant friction; medium = notable issue; low = cosmetic.

action.description: Action taken: fixed = resolved before submission; deferred = noted for backlog; accepted = acceptable trade-off; escalated = sent to Tech Lead.

resolution.description: How the issue was resolved (required if action is 'fixed').

overall_verdict.description: PASS: no critical or high issues unresolved. PASS_WITH_NOTES: medium/low issues deferred. FAIL: critical or high issues not resolved — cannot submit.

critical_issues_unresolved.description: Number of critical-severity issues not yet resolved. Must be 0 for PASS or PASS_WITH_NOTES.

high_issues_unresolved.description: Number of high-severity issues not yet resolved. Must be 0 for PASS.
